messages:
sophia: Heads-up — found a flaky repro in the Next starter sample (edge/RAG) where concurrent streaming requests cause auth to hit a retry loop and keep the socket open. Repro steps below.

sophia: Repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/next-rag-sample (branch: edge-keepsocket). Steps: pnpm install && pnpm dev, open /demo, click 'stream answer' twice fast. After ~2s one request 401s, JS SDK retries endlessly and both streams hang.

sophia: Minimal log excerpt: 
```
GET /api/generate 200
POST /api/stream 401 
redwood-sdk: retry attempt 1
redwood-sdk: retry attempt 2
...
socket: still open
```

sophia: Hypothesis: the browser SDK's in-flight token refresh race leaves the socket in a half-closed state when using the edge runtime + keep-alive. Python SDK doesn't show this.

anita: thanks for the clear repro — this smells like SDK parity + auth middleware race. do we have a token refresh mutex in js sdk?

sophia: not robustly — there is a simple lock but it doesn't gate streaming handshake path.

derek: quick workaround: set stream=false or serialize requests client-side. not great for demos though. also try bumping to @redwood/sdk@0.9.1-rc which I pushed earlier (adds backoff/lock).

kevin: can you paste the client call? might be an issue in how the fetch is created (keepalive: true?)

sophia: client snippet: 
```js
const res = await redwood.chat.stream({ model: 'open-rag', messages, options: { keepAlive: true } })
```

sophia: removing keepAlive fixes it for now. but we should fix SDK to avoid forcing demos to change.

anita: filing an issue on the sdk board and marking as p0 for next sprint. please add a small repro test in devex/eval-harness to catch this regression.

ci-bot: Issue created: RED-DEVEX-4125 — "JS SDK: streaming token-refresh race closes socket" (assignee: derek).

kevin: will add a unit that simulates concurrent token expiry + streaming handshake. also check RN/edge differences.

derek: patch idea: add a streaming-handshake gate that waits for auth mutex to resolve and honor abort signals. PR incoming today.

sophia: awesome — once PR lands I'll update the sample branch and run the eval harness (streaming latency + correctness) to ensure parity vs python. thanks :thumbsup:

kevin: note for docs: add a short "concurrency gotcha" note in the Next starter readme until we ship the fix.

anita: copying product so they know sample apps might be flaky in workshops. @maria FYI.

sophia: posting the final test case here for convenience: 
```bash
# repro test (curl-based)
for i in 1 2; do 
curl -sS -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/stream -d '{"q":"test"}' &
done
wait
```

sophia: tl;dr: reproducible concurrency auth+streaming bug in Next starter; workaround remove keepAlive; fix in flight in SDK.
